description: This file defines a template class 'LinkType' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, implementing a generic link/channel mechanism with serialization/deserialization and handler support for inbound and outbound data, including methods for managing connection state and data transmission.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: A template class representing a generic communication link with serialization, deserialization, and handler support, managing connection state and data flow.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying link/channel object.

methods.name: Link (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the underlying link/channel object.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the link/channel.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method called when a request is received.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method called to send a response.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method called on channel state change.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound object into the channel if it is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the channel has an error.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the channel to process data.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Serializes data into the data frame for sending.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Deserializes received data from the data frame.
